title: create custom audiences in ad manager
text:
In this article we will be elaborating on the steps one needs to take to create Custom Audiences and how to use it during the campaign creation process in Ad Manager.

What is a Meta Custom Audience?

A Meta Custom Audience is a reusable audience created from a supported data or engagement source. HighLevel currently documents Custom Audience creation from Website, Facebook Page, Lead Form, and Customer List sources.

The information required to create the audience depends on the selected source. After Meta processes the audience and its status becomes Ready, you can select it for eligible campaign retargeting.
Key Benefits of Meta Custom Audiences

Custom Audiences help you reuse supported audience data when configuring Meta campaign retargeting.

Multiple audience sources: Create audiences from supported website activity, Facebook Page engagement, Lead Form activity, or customer data.

Reusable retargeting: Select a ready Custom Audience when configuring eligible Meta campaigns.

Inline creation: Create a Custom Audience without leaving the campaign setup workflow.

Centralized management: Create and manage audiences from Ad Manager Settings.

Dynamic customer audiences: Supported Dynamic Smart List audiences can add and remove contacts as the source Smart List changes.

Where To Create Meta Custom Audiences

HighLevel provides two ways to start creating a Meta Custom Audience. Create audiences in advance from Ad Manager Settings or create one while configuring the Retargeting audience for a campaign.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081853331/original/A_-mLUnxXsnfEuzDt0D5IvrmBERhCnze6w.gif?1790333946]  [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032046541/original/la7oYcVgsTb5_beMtbMZjR3NpdjWbgxP5g.png?1725263370] 
Under the Retargeting tab, when you click on the dropdown to 'Create new or select retargeting audience', the first option in the list is to "Create a Custom Audience"

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032046676/original/UjUV8mwhEqGvoR0sjNobcLf3bBT5F0JUbQ.png?1725263468] 
How to create a custom audience?

This type of target audience refers to a group of people who are familiar with your brand/product and have interacted with it earlier at some point in any of the Meta platform. We will be using custom audience curated especially to target these set of people with our ad campaign.
Creation of a custom audience is a two step process, both the steps are listed as follows:

On clicking the 'Create a Custom Audience' button, a modal dialog opens up allowing users to select a custom audience source that will be used to create a custom audience depending on the source selected.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032074908/original/iRkOvncYovWnaHnulQDP01oLA0nhHvw8tQ.png?1725279035] 

Once a source is chosen and user clicks on 'Next', they will be navigated to the second step of custom audience creation and a dialog is presented with its constituents depending on which source is selected.

Ex: If 'Website' is selected, the second step to create a custom audience will look like -

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032027934/original/3I-ROujCAoOr7t1n6Jnwa_DhdJybjFeZ7g.png?1725204058] 
Pixel: The list of all the pixels that exists within HL Ad Manager will be shown in the dropdown and one of them can be selected.

Events: Choose the event you want to be considered as the pivot for your audience creation. There are two options:
1. All website visitors - It refers to all the people who have visited or interacted with your website.
2. Visitors by time spent - It refers to the people who have spent the most time on your website and can be further narrowed down by selecting a percentile.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032030426/original/J7aIOMxy1nUKyVg6FXpK0_gAaPV446X3SA.png?1725214948] 

Example on how to use percentile: If I select 10% then that means the audience which will be used for consideration will include the the visitors who were in the 10% of time spent on your website.

Audience retention: It refers to the number of days users will remain in your audience after they have interacted with your content. In case of Website audience, 30 days is the maximum allowed limit.

Note: Additionally, four more clauses can be added similar to the one described above with the condition for them to be included along with the default clause or excluded by clicking on the 'Include more people' and 'Exclude people' respectively.

Add an audience name and description for easy distinction.
How to create a Website Custom Audience?

All the details related to creating a Website custom audience is explained in the above section as an example.
How to create a Facebook Page Custom Audience?

By selecting the 'Facebook Page' as the custom audience source from the first stepper dialog, users can proceed to create an audience of people who follow or have interacted with your page and proceed to define the audience specifics in the second step.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032031381/original/JMqeJVsgaSsJCMuX1cjdvkbpU6XfB6pxcQ.png?1725220420] 

Page: The list of all the pages that are integrated with Ad Manager will be shown in the dropdown and one of them can be selected.

Events: Choose the event you want to be considered as the pivot for your audience creation. There are 7 options in the dropdown list of events out of which one can be selected.

Audience retention: It refers to the number of days users will remain in your audience after they have interacted with your content. In case of Facebook Page audience, 365 days is the maximum allowed limit.

Note: Additionally, four more clauses can be added similar to the one described above with the condition for them to be included along with the default clause or excluded by clicking on the 'Include more people' and 'Exclude people' respectively.
Add an audience name and description for easy distinction.

How to create a Lead Form Custom Audience?

By selecting the 'Lead Form' as the custom audience source from the first stepper dialog, users can proceed to create an audience of people who have opened or completed a form in one of your lead generation ads on Facebook or Instagram and proceed to define the audience specifics in the second step.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032031471/original/lea8hUvL-6Kkv_lwVYLJfa2GniZ2Gciy0w.png?1725221032] 

Events: Choose the event you want to be considered as the pivot for your audience creation. There are 3 options in the dropdown list of events out of which one can be selected:
1. Users who opened and submitted form
2. Users who opened but didn't submit form
3. Anyone who opened the form

Page: The list of all the pages that are integrated with Ad Manager will be shown in the dropdown and one of them can be selected.

Lead form: Based on the page selected, all the lead forms associated with the selected page will be present as part of the lead form dropdown list and one can be selected. This is the form which will be considered to curate audience who've interacted with this form.

Audience retention: It refers to the number of days users will remain in your audience after they have interacted with your content. In case of Lead Form audience, 90 days is the maximum allowed limit.

Note: Additionally, four more clauses can be added similar to the one described above with the condition for them to be included along with the default clause or excluded by clicking on the 'Include more people' and 'Exclude people' respectively.
Add an audience name and description for easy distinction.

Note: Once a custom audience is successfully created, it will be shown as part of the Retargeting Audience dropdown list and can be used for creating a campaign once the status of the newly created audience is ready.
How to create a Customer List Custom Audience? 

By selecting ‘Customer List’ as the custom audience source from the first stepper dialog, users can choose CSV Upload or Smart List and proceed to define audience specifics in the second step.

A Meta Customer List Custom Audience lets you use your own customer data (emails, phone numbers, etc.) in Ad Manager to reach specific individuals on Facebook and Instagram. The data is matched to user profiles so you can deliver targeted ads.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062435127/original/be_WNZOjkP7BF9dpwObUi7OezhCQoe9fEQ.png?1768213857]

MethodHow it worksKey notes
Upload FileUpload a CSV file with customer identifiers (e.g., emails, phone numbers) to create the audience.Must follow  [https://www.facebook.com/business/help/2082575038703844?id=2469097953376494] Meta's formatting guidelines; upload fails if headers/values are invalid.
Use Smart Lists → StaticCreate the audience from an existing HighLevel Smart List and freeze it at creation time.Includes only contacts present at creation; does not update later.
Use Smart Lists → DynamicLink to a HighLevel Smart List that updates Dynamically as the list changes.Adds/removes contacts automatically when the Smart List updates.
Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Where can I create a Meta Custom Audience in HighLevel? 
You can create one from Ad Manager Settings or while configuring Retargeting at the Ad Set level of a Meta campaign.

Q: Which Custom Audience sources are documented in HighLevel? 
The current article documents Website, Facebook Page, Lead Form, and Customer List sources.

Q: Why can't I select the Custom Audience I just created?
The audience must reach Ready status before it can be selected. HighLevel prevents selection of audiences that are still Not Ready.

Q: Can I create a Customer List audience from a HighLevel Smart List?
Yes. The Customer List workflow supports HighLevel Smart Lists.

Q: What is the difference between a Static and Dynamic Smart List audience?
Static audiences keep the membership captured at creation. Dynamic audiences add and remove members as the source Smart List changes.

Q: Can I select more than one Retargeting audience?
Yes. Current HighLevel Audience Controls documentation allows up to 15 Retargeting audiences.

Q: Why might Meta restrict a Custom Audience?
Meta can restrict audiences that contain or imply information prohibited under its terms. Review the dedicated restrictions article for current requirements.
